Class GodModeDisasterExecutor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.godmode.GodModeDisasterExecutor
public final class GodModeDisasterExecutor extends Object
Execution engine for physical forcing, disaster injection, and terraforming actions in God Mode.

Directly modifies cellular simulation states (population, biomass, aquifers, climate, infrastructure integrity) following geophysical laws and cliodynamic shocks.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
